description: This file defines a PDO database abstraction class for the OpenCart system, encapsulating connection setup, query execution, and utility methods for database interactions.

classes.name: PDO
classes.description: A database communication class that wraps PHP's PDO extension to manage MySQL connections for OpenCart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PDO connection with provided options, sets session variables, and handles connection errors.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement, returning result object, number of affected rows, or boolean; supports prepared statement with named parameters.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Creates a named parameter placeholder for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last write operation.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted auto-increment ID after an insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.
